chars.OUSSAMA: OUSSAMA: a young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans and white sneakers.
chars.FATHER: FATHER: an older man with a grey moustache wearing a brown wool djellaba and a white knitted cap.
chars.MOTHER: MOTHER: an older woman wearing a green floral house kaftan and a beige headscarf.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: OUSSAMA sits alone on the edge of his bed in a small modest bedroom in a Casablanca apartment at night, elbows on knees, hands on his face, thinking hard, worried, dim lamp light

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: OUSSAMA stands at the edge of the Tangier port at dusk, looking far away at a big ferry ship leaving, holding his open empty wallet in one hand, sad longing expression

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: in a Moroccan living room with low sedari couches and a round table with a tea tray, FATHER points his finger angrily at OUSSAMA while MOTHER sits beside, worried; OUSSAMA looks down ashamed

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: in the same Moroccan living room, OUSSAMA stands and explains with open hands, frustrated, while FATHER sits on the couch shaking his head, unconvinced

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: MOTHER stands alone in a small Moroccan kitchen, leaning on the counter, wiping a tear, a pot on the stove, evening light, heavy sad mood

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: OUSSAMA walks alone with hunched shoulders on a busy Casablanca street with white buildings, people pass by around him without looking at him, he feels invisible and lonely

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: OUSSAMA lies on his bed staring at the ceiling, exhausted and depressed, a framed university diploma hangs on the wall above him, curtains closed, grey light

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: OUSSAMA sits at a small desk at night in front of a glowing laptop, leaning forward with surprised eyes, a new message notification glow lighting his face, cup of tea beside
